title: Draftsman
jobDescription:
Job Title: Draftsman (Mechanical / Civil)

Location: Yelahanka, Bangalore

Department:

Engineering / Design / Projects

Job Summary:

We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Draftsman to prepare high-quality 2D and 3D technical drawings across mechanical and civil domains. The role involves developing accurate engineering drawings, supporting manufacturing and project execution, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure design precision and compliance with standards.

Key RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Prepare detailed 2D and 3D drawings using tools like Auto CAD, Solid Works, and Autodesk Inventor.
  • Develop architectural, structural, and mechanical drawings including layouts, elevations, and sectional views.
  • Create manufacturing drawings with accurate dimensions, tolerances, and annotations.
  • Generate site plans, floor layouts, and structural drawings for engineering projects.
  • Design and draft components such as pallets, connectors, fixtures, and back shells.
  • Define machining processes, raw material specifications, and routing for production.
  • Prepare and maintain Bill of Materials (BOM) and update engineering documentation.
  • Ensure proper revision control and documentation management for all drawings.
  • Coordinate with manufacturing, quality, and project teams for design validation and implementation.
  • Support process planning, control plans, and inspection documentation.
  • Assist in reverse engineering, prototyping, and 3D printing activities where required.
  • Ensure compliance with GD&T standards and engineering best practices.

Required Skills & Competencies:

  • Strong proficiency in Auto CAD (2D & 3D)
  • Hands-on experience with Solid Works / Autodesk Inventor
  • Good understanding of Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing (GD&T)
  • Knowledge of manufacturing processes and machining techniques
  • Familiarity with BOM, process flow, and control plans
  • Basic understanding of materials and fabrication processes
  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and specifications
  • Good coordination and communication skills
  • Proficiency in MS Office tools

Educational Qualification:

  • ITI / Diploma in Mechanical Draftsmanship / Civil Engineering / Mechanical Engineering

Experience:

  • 2–5 years of experience in drafting (mechanical / civil / manufacturing environment preferred)

Preferred Experience:

  • Experience in defence, manufacturing, or engineering design environments
  • Exposure to fixture design, tooling, or production support
  • Hands-on involvement in inspection, validation, or shop-floor coordination

title: PPC Manager
jobDescription:
Job Description: Production Planning & Control (PPC) Manager (7~10 Years Experience)

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Production Planning & Control (PPC) Manager to oversee end‑to‑end production planning, scheduling, inventory control, and coordination with cross‑functional teams. The ideal candidate will have 7~10 years of hands‑on experience in manufacturing operations, with strong analytical, planning, and leadership capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

1. Production Planning & Scheduling

  • Develop daily, weekly, and monthly production plans to meet delivery timelines.

  • Create capacity plans based on manpower, machine availability, and material readiness.

  • Monitor production workflow and identify bottlenecks to ensure smooth operations.

2. Inventory & Material Management

  • Maintain optimum inventory levels of raw materials, WIP, and finished goods.

  • Coordinate with procurement for timely material replenishment.

  • Track stock levels, safety stock, and consumption patterns to reduce material shortages.

3. Coordination with Departments

  • Work closely with production, quality, procurement, and logistics teams.

  • Coordinate with design/R&D and sales teams for order planning and customization requirements.

  • Ensure on-time production and dispatch to meet customer and sales commitments.

4. Process Monitoring & Control

  • Analyse production data, lead times, cycle times, and process performance metrics.

  • Implement production control systems and continuous improvement methods (Lean, Kaizen, 5S).

  • Track deviations, downtime, rework, and ensure corrective action implementation.

5. Reporting & Documentation

  • Prepare MIS reports: production performance, capacity utilization, material shortages, order status, etc.

  • Maintain accurate documentation of production schedules, work orders, and inventory movement.

  • Present weekly and monthly performance reports to management.

6. Compliance & Quality Coordination

  • Work with quality teams to ensure adherence to standards and compliance.

  • Support audits and maintain traceability of production data.

Required Skills & Experience

Experience

  • 5–6 years of relevant experience in production planning, production control, or manufacturing operations.

  • Experience working in automotive, engineering, FMCG, electronics, textile, or similar manufacturing industries.

Technical Skills

  • Strong knowledge of PPC processes, BOM, routing, production cycles, and capacity planning.

  • Proficiency in ERP systems (SAP).

  • Strong analytical skills with advanced knowledge of Excel/Sheets.

Educational Qualification

  • B.Tech / B.E. in Mechanical, Production, Industrial Engineering (preferred).

  • MBA in Operations (added advantage).

title: Quality Manager
jobDescription:
Position Summary – Lead - Quality

RoleLead – Quality
LocationHosur, Tamil Nadu
Reporting ToQuality Head / BU Head
Experience8–15+ years (Minimum 5 years in senior quality leadership)
IndustryAerospace / Defence Manufacturing

The Lead – Quality will lead the Quality Assurance & Quality Control function for advanced Defence products including thermal imaging sights, radar systems, multi-mode grenades, electronic fuses, electro-optics, and other Defence systems. The role is responsible for ensuring compliance with Aerospace, Defence, and regulatory standards while driving zero-defect manufacturing, supplier quality excellence, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

AreaResponsibilities
Quality Management System (QMS)Develop, implement, and maintain Quality Management Systems (QMS) aligned with AS9100 Rev D, ISO 9001, Nadcap, APQP, PPAP, and customer-specific quality requirements.
Regulatory & Customer ComplianceCoordinate with defence agencies and regulatory authorities including DGQA, DRDO, ISRO, HAL, BEL, and other customers to ensure compliance with applicable standards and contractual quality requirements.
Product Quality AssuranceEnsure quality assurance throughout the product lifecycle including incoming inspection, in-process inspection, final inspection, First Article Inspection (FAI), qualification, validation, and customer acceptance.
Supplier Quality ManagementDrive supplier quality development through supplier audits, qualification, vendor performance monitoring, corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), and supplier improvement initiatives.
Testing & ValidationOversee functional, environmental, vibration, EMI/EMC, reliability, and qualification testing to ensure products meet customer and regulatory requirements.
Process ImprovementLead Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), FMEA, SPC, Kaizen, and continuous improvement initiatives to reduce defects and improve process capability.
Quality Audits & CompliancePlan and conduct internal, supplier, process, and system audits. Ensure timely closure of audit findings and compliance with quality standards.
Cross-Functional CollaborationWork closely with Design, Manufacturing, SCM, Production, Projects, and Customer teams to resolve quality issues and support new product development and project execution.
Team LeadershipLead, mentor, and develop Quality Engineers and Inspectors by establishing performance goals, competency development plans, and continuous learning initiatives.
Customer SupportSupport customer inspections, product demonstrations, Pre-Dispatch Inspections (PDI), Joint Receipt Inspections (JRI), Failure Analysis, warranty support, and customer complaint resolution.

Qualifications

Preferred CertificationsAS9100 Lead Auditor, ISO 9001 Lead Auditor, Lean Six Sigma Green/Black Belt, APQP/PPAP, Nadcap Internal Auditor
Technical SkillsAS9100 Rev D, ISO 9001, Nadcap, APQP, PPAP, FAI (AS9102), GD&T, FMEA, SPC, CAPA, Root Cause Analysis, Supplier Quality, Quality Audits, SAP/ERP, Quality Documentation

Key Competencies

  • Strong leadership and people management skills.
  • Thorough knowledge of Aerospace and Defence quality standards.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Customer-focused with a zero-defect manufacturing mindset.
  • Expertise in Quality Management Systems and regulatory compliance.

title: Team Member-FA, R&D Support
jobDescription:
Position: Manager – Finance & Accounts (Insurance, TDS & Compliance)
Department: Finance & Accounts
Reporting To: Sr. Manager Finance & Accounts

Job Summary

The Manager – Finance & Accounts (Insurance, TDS & Compliance) is responsible for managing direct tax compliance (primarily TDS), corporate insurance portfolio, accounting controls, statutory compliance, audits, and financial reporting. The role ensures timely compliance with tax laws, adequate insurance coverage of company assets and liabilities, and adherence to accounting and regulatory requirements.

Key Responsibilities

1. TDS Management & Direct Tax Compliance

  • Ensure accurate deduction, deposit, and reporting of TDS as per applicable provisions of the Income Tax Act.

  • Review vendor, employee, contractor, rent, professional fee, interest, commission, and other payments for TDS applicability.

  • Monitor lower/nil deduction certificates and exemptions.

  • File quarterly TDS returns (Form 24Q, 26Q, 27Q, etc.) within statutory timelines.

  • Reconcile TDS ledgers with books of accounts and Form 26AS/TRACES records.

  • Coordinate issuance of TDS certificates (Form 16 & Form 16A).

  • Handle notices, assessments, surveys, and departmental correspondence related to TDS matters.

  • Ensure compliance with changes under the Income-tax Act and related rules.

2. Insurance Management

  • Manage the company's entire insurance portfolio including:

    • Property Insurance

    • Fire & Special Perils Insurance

    • Marine Transit Insurance

    • Employee Group Medical Insurance

    • Group Personal Accident Insurance

    • Directors & Officers Liability Insurance

    • Cyber Insurance

    • Fidelity Guarantee Insurance

    • Workmen Compensation Insurance

  • Review adequacy of insurance coverage and policy terms.

  • Coordinate policy renewals and premium payments.

  • Liaise with insurance brokers, insurers, surveyors, and legal teams.

  • Manage insurance claims, documentation, claim settlements, and recovery follow-up.

  • Conduct periodic risk assessments and recommend risk mitigation measures.

3. Finance & Accounting

  • Oversee accounting entries related to taxation, insurance, provisions, and accruals.

  • Review general ledger balances and ensure accuracy of financial records.

  • Monitor month-end, quarter-end, and year-end closing activities.

  • Ensure compliance with accounting standards and company policies.

  • Review provisions for expenses, liabilities, and contingent obligations.

4. Statutory & Regulatory Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with Income Tax, GST, Companies Act, FEMA, and other applicable regulations.

  • Support preparation and filing of statutory returns and disclosures.

  • Track changes in tax and regulatory laws impacting the organization.

  • Implement compliance frameworks and internal controls.

5. Audit & Assessments

  • Coordinate with Statutory Auditors, Internal Auditors, Tax Auditors, and Regulatory Authorities.

  • Prepare schedules and documentation required during audits.

  • Resolve audit observations and ensure timely closure of audit findings.

  • Support tax assessments and departmental inquiries.

6. MIS & Reporting

  • Prepare periodic compliance dashboards and management reports.

  • Monitor TDS liabilities, insurance claims, policy renewals, and compliance status.

  • Present risk and compliance updates to senior management.

  • Analyze trends and recommend process improvements.

7. Team Management

  • Lead and mentor finance and compliance team members.

  • Establish SOPs and process controls.

  • Ensure timely completion of assigned activities and statutory deadlines.

  • Drive automation and process improvement initiatives within ERP/SAP.

Educational Qualification

  • CMA / MBA (Finance) / B.Com/M.Com may be considered with relevant experience.

Experience

  • 3–8 years of experience in Finance & Accounts.

  • Strong exposure to TDS, direct tax compliance, insurance management, audits, and regulatory compliance.

  • Experience in manufacturing, telecom, infrastructure, EPC, or large corporate environments preferred.

Technical Skills

  • In-depth knowledge of Income Tax Act, TDS provisions, and TRACES compliance.

  • Understanding of insurance policies, claim management, and risk assessment.

  • Working knowledge of GST and corporate taxation.

  • Experience with SAP (FI), Oracle, or similar ERP systems.

  • Advanced proficiency in MS Excel and financial reporting tools.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • 100% compliance with TDS filing and payment timelines.

  • Zero or minimal tax penalties and notices.

  • Timely renewal of all insurance policies.

  • Insurance claim settlement ratio and turnaround time.

  • Closure of audit observations within agreed timelines.

  • Accuracy of financial reporting and reconciliations.

  • Compliance scorecard and internal control effectiveness.

Authority & Accountability

  • Approve TDS compliance reviews and tax reconciliations.

  • Review insurance coverage and recommend policy procurement/renewal.

  • Ensure statutory compliance and audit readiness.

  • Accountable for tax, insurance, and compliance-related financial risks.

  • Responsible for safeguarding company assets through adequate insurance coverage and effective compliance controls.

title: Team Member-Travel & Expense Accounting
jobDescription:
Job Description – Executive (Reimbursements)

Position: Executive – Reimbursements
Department: Finance & Accounts
Reporting To: Manager – Finance & Accounts / Accounts Payable Manager

Job Summary

The Executive – Reimbursements is responsible for processing employee reimbursement claims, ensuring compliance with company policies, maintaining accurate records, and facilitating timely settlement of employee expenses. The role requires close coordination with employees, HR, administration, and finance teams to ensure efficient and compliant reimbursement processing.

Key Responsibilities

1. Employee Reimbursement Processing

  • Review and process employee reimbursement claims for travel, conveyance, lodging, meals, mobile, internet, medical, and other approved business expenses.

  • Verify supporting documents, bills, receipts, approvals, and policy compliance.

  • Ensure claims are processed accurately and within prescribed timelines.

  • Identify and resolve discrepancies in submitted claims.

2. Travel & Expense (T&E) Management

  • Scrutinize travel expense claims against approved travel policies.

  • Verify travel approvals, supporting invoices, boarding passes, hotel bills, and related documents.

  • Ensure proper accounting and settlement of travel advances.

  • Monitor pending advances and follow up for timely adjustment.

3. Policy Compliance & Controls

title: Shift In-charge
jobDescription:
Purpose of the Role

To lead and coordinate all mechanical maintenance activities during the assigned shift, ensuring maximum equipment availability, minimum downtime, safe operations, and timely execution of preventive and breakdown maintenance while supporting uninterrupted production.

Key Responsibilities

1. Breakdown Maintenance

  • Lead and coordinate mechanical breakdown maintenance activities to restore equipment within the targeted time.
  • Diagnose mechanical failures and ensure effective root cause analysis (RCA).
  • Coordinate with production teams to minimize production losses due to equipment failures.
  • Maintain records of all breakdowns, corrective actions, and downtime.

2. Preventive & Predictive Maintenance

  • Ensure timely execution of preventive maintenance (PM) schedules.
  • Support predictive maintenance activities such as vibration monitoring, thermography, lubrication analysis, and condition monitoring.
  • Verify the quality of maintenance work before equipment handover.
  • Ensure compliance with maintenance checklists and SOPs.

3. Team Leadership

  • Supervise technicians and contract manpower during the shift.
  • Allocate maintenance jobs based on priority and manpower availability.
  • Monitor team performance and provide technical guidance.
  • Ensure proper shift handover with complete status of ongoing work.

4. Equipment Reliability

  • Improve equipment reliability through effective maintenance planning and execution.
  • Identify recurring failures and implement permanent corrective actions.
  • Recommend equipment modifications and reliability improvement initiatives.
  • Support TPM, Autonomous Maintenance, and Reliability Improvement projects.

5. Safety & Compliance

  • Ensure strict compliance with EHS policies, Permit-to-Work (PTW), Lockout/Tagout (LOTO), and other safety procedures.
  • Conduct toolbox talks before critical maintenance activities.
  • Ensure safe use of tools, lifting equipment, and PPE.
  • Report and investigate unsafe conditions, near misses, and incidents.

6. Spare Parts & Resource Management

  • Monitor the availability of critical spare parts and maintenance consumables.
  • Coordinate with the stores department for timely issuance of spares.
  • Ensure proper utilization and care of maintenance tools and equipment.
  • Recommend stocking levels for critical spares.

7. Documentation & Reporting

  • Maintain accurate maintenance logs, shift reports, equipment history, and downtime records.
  • Update CMMS/SAP maintenance records (where applicable).
  • Prepare shift-wise maintenance reports and communicate key issues during shift handover.

8. Continuous Improvement

  • Participate in Kaizen, Lean Manufacturing, TPM, and cost reduction initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities to improve equipment efficiency and reduce maintenance costs.
  • Support implementation of energy-saving and reliability improvement projects.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Equipment availability and reliability.
  • Mean Time to Repair (MTTR).
  • Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF).
  • Breakdown response and restoration time.
  • Preventive maintenance schedule compliance.
  • Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) support.
  • Maintenance cost control.
  • Zero safety violations and incident-free maintenance activities.
  • Timely closure of maintenance work orders.

Qualification

  • Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering.

Experience

  • Typically 6–8 years of experience in mechanical maintenance within a manufacturing or process industry.
  • Experience in leading shift maintenance teams is preferred.

Preferred Skills

  • Strong knowledge of pumps, gearboxes, conveyors, compressors, hydraulic and pneumatic systems, bearings, rotating equipment, and utility equipment.
  • Knowledge of TPM, RCA, FMEA, 5 Why Analysis, and preventive maintenance practices.
  • Familiarity with CMMS/SAP PM modules.
  • Strong troubleshooting and decision-making skills.
  • Good leadership, communication, and team management abilities.
  • Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities.
